mapper.sql: id, purchase_date, material_id, material_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, qty, unit, unit_price, total, pay_status, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM purchase
ORDER BY purchase_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS month_total, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE pay_status='pending'),0) AS unpaid, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(total)),0) AS avg FROM purchase WHERE to_char(purchase_date,'YYYY-MM') = #{month}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase (purchase_date, material_id, material_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, qty, unit, unit_price, total, pay_status) VALUES (#{purchaseDate}, #{materialId}, #{materialName}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{qty}, #{unit}, #{unitPrice}, #{total}, #{payStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase SET pay_status = #{payStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
